Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding invite — seeing 'Unauthorized' after clicking link

Packaging up what I see from the SSO side. This looks like a relay-state mismatch: the invite flow uses an SP-initiated URL that sets a relayState parameter pointing to the vendor tenant's onboarding page, but in some cases the relayState is getting overwritten by an older cached value or a misrouted IdP-initiated redirect. The symptom (redirecting to a different tenant + Unauthorized) fits exactly.

What we'll do:
- Confirm our SAML metadata (attached) is correct and current for the Workday SP.
- Check our load balancer logs for any rewrites on /saml/acs that could drop relayState.
- Generate a direct invite token that lands the user on an SP-initiated flow without relayState and expire it after 24 hours.

Susan/Thomas: can you try the alternate flow when Mina sends it? If it still fails, include the browser console/network HAR so we can see the redirect chain.

Attachment: saml-metadata.xml
KB: https://redwood.internal/kb/saml-relaystate-mapping

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer

Hi Susan/Thomas — thanks for the extra detail and the HAR (very helpful). Karthik confirms this is a relay-state mapping issue on a small percentage of SP-initiated invites; our load balancer rewrite rule is intermittently dropping the vendor-id from the relayState when a cached route is used. We've opened a ticket with SRE to rotate the rewrite rule and patch the header handling — ETA for a fix is this afternoon.

Workaround (immediate):
- I generated a temporary direct invite link that bypasses relayState and lands you on the Highline tenant onboarding form. Link valid for 24 hours: (sent as attachment temp-invite-link.txt).
- If the direct link works, please complete the form; I'll confirm PO routing and ensure your account is added to the vendor list.

Follow-up: once SRE confirms the fix, I'll resend a standard invite so your team has the branded email flow. Also looping Laura (Vendor Ops) to confirm we have Highline's billing remittance details so POs route correctly after onboarding.

Apologies for the disruption — we're prioritizing this and will update you when the SRE change is live.

Best,
